title: Formosa Foundation 福爾摩沙基金會
content_html: The Formosa Foundation is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization based in Los Angeles, California, dedicated to advancing human rights, democracy, and Taiwan’s right to self-determination. It fosters understanding and exchange of ideas between the United States and Taiwan through educational and advocacy efforts. The Foundation supports peace, freedom, and regional stability in East Asia, and promotes policies that safeguard shared U.S.-Taiwan interests. It critiques U.S. strategic ambiguity and the One China Policy as contributing to cross-strait tensions and undermining Taiwan’s international recognition.
